property_summary: For every call to fallback with msg.value == 10 ether and block.timestamp strictly increasing, the reference contract only pays out (empties its balance) when block.number % 15 == 0; the mutant inverts this condition and will sometimes pay out when block.number % 15 != 0, causing a differing post-call contract balance/state for some fuzzed block numbers.
change_summary: Invert the conditional so transfer happens when block.number % 15 != 0 instead of == 0, altering when payouts occur and thus observable balance/state.
